newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Shell signs $360 mln loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Shell signs $360 mln loan deal.

text.p: Shell Refining Company (FOM) Bhd on Wednesday announced it has obtained a $360 million, eight-year syndicated loan facility.
Shell Refining, a part of Royal Dutch/Shell group, said in a statement that the loan was co-arranged by Standard Chartered Bank and Arab-Malaysian Merchant Bank Bhd.
The loan would finance Shell Refining's investments including the construction of a one-billion-ringgit Long Residue Catalytic Cracking Complex, the company's chairman Megat Zaharuddin said.
The loan was on a floating rate basis. It will be repaid in 18 equal quarterly instalments beginning September, 2000.
